dataset.name: A3 Refund Demo Dataset
dataset.description: Minimal demo dataset for A3 ReleaseFoundry dashboard calibration. Refund/cancellation workflow only.

agent.name: A3 Refund Demo Agent
agent.description: A minimal test support agent used by the A3 dashboard team to calibrate refund, cancellation, trace, tool-call, and expected-versus-actual UI behavior.

tool.name: confirm_cancel
tool.description: Confirms a booking cancellation and issues the eligible refund when policy allows it.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: Booking identifier used to confirm cancellation and refund.

context.use_case: Test whether a support agent correctly handles a refund request, verifies order eligibility, calls the correct refund confirmation tool, and explains the expected refund outcome.
context.scenario_context: Customer asks to cancel or refund a recent order within the allowed policy window. The agent should not claim refund completion unless the correct tool call succeeds.
context.sample_data: Order IDs, receipt files, refund policy window, tool-call result, expected refund amount, and customer message history.

test_config.focus_area: refund eligibility, tool-call correctness, receipt file/image/audio evidence

a3_implications: Official ReleaseFoundry creates evaluation data through a dataset generation wizard rather than a standalone A3-style triage console.
Agent identity, accepted inputs, tools, context, generation config, and behavior criteria are upstream provenance that A3 should display on reports.
Media support is configured as accepted input types at dataset generation time: text, audio, file, image, video, website simulation, and custom schema.
Tool-call correctness maps directly to the A3 Tool Call Diff and Expected vs Actual panels.
The official Review step is a useful model for A3's Report Center and audit export summary.
